recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-11020; any future changes to the migrated certainty extension should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack or by a new Patient Care decision.
issue_request: FHIR-11020 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2 AllergyIntolerance. It asked for a use case for AllergyIntolerance.reaction.certainty, and Patient Care resolved to move Reaction.certainty to an extension.
initial_application: Commit 68550659bae9230325fa334363c569fc10d9ceb1 applied the issue by marking AllergyIntolerance.reaction.certainty as moved out of the core resource spreadsheet, removing certainty values from core examples, and adding the certainty element and reaction-event-certainty binding to the AllergyIntolerance extension spreadsheet. Commit 5176090fead928103c618a284bb4b930a83ae97e later updated the AllergyIntolerance STU note to reference the extension.
additional_context: AllergyIntolerance is active in the current core build. The current AllergyIntolerance StructureDefinition has no reaction.certainty child, while the FHIR Extension Pack contains StructureDefinition/allergyintolerance-certainty scoped to AllergyIntolerance.reaction and the reaction-event-certainty terminology. Related FHIR-11022 and FHIR-13459 audits are already present on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source changes were made. The current core checkout already reflects the accepted decision, and the moved extension artifacts belong to the Extension Pack rather than this core source tree.

related_jiras.note: Earlier certainty value-set request recommended adding unknown but using an extension/profile for additional local certainty concepts.
Clarified the unknown certainty code and was explicitly part of the same block vote; already audited on the combined branch.
Later changed extension-allergyintolerance-certainty to CodeableConcept with extensible binding; already audited on the combined branch.
